Party 1 was then reloaded and used for step 4 and step 6.
A record text reads "so █ve does not lower": the harness scrub cut two letters of the word Save out of the kept text; the picture 840-05 and depositSave.message carry the words whole.
Step 6: with no package on the party the till has no quote and names no deposit; the park birthday package was applied on party 1 and the till then read Deposit paid 4,000.
